note: Routes requests to self-host the Ironside + Coeval evaluation loop, capture local agent sessions, or bootstrap governed local judging. It must stay out of generic eval writing, existing-instance CI gates, hosted platforms, observability-only work, and production multi-user deployments.
should_trigger: Help me self-host the full local agent evaluation stack with Ironside traces, Coeval judging, and Casefile scans.
Set up Ironside and Coeval on my workstation so I can capture skill runs and adjudicate judged results locally.
Import my latest Codex and Claude Code sessions into a local Ironside instance and tag which skills were used.
Wire this pi agent to my own Ironside trace store, then help me create a calibrated Coeval judge for its sessions.
I want a governed, local-first evaluation loop for agent skills with human adjudication and golden sets.
Bootstrap one local Coeval bench project per skill and verify captured Ironside traces before judging them.

should_not.prompt: Write a five-point rubric for judging whether support answers are empathetic.
Add a Coeval gate to CI; our Coeval instance and judge projects are already running.
Recommend a hosted LLM observability SaaS for our production platform.
Deploy Ironside and Coeval as a public multi-tenant company service with SSO.
Create three behavioral eval prompts for this new skill and add them to qa/evals.
Debug why our existing Docker Compose service cannot reach Postgres.
Add OpenTelemetry tracing to this Node API; no agent or LLM evaluation is involved.
Scan this repository for secrets and risky install scripts with Casefile.
Fold last month's coeval override reasons back into the judged natural-writing skill and open the patch PR.
